name: proportionality
wording: the ceremony of a cut scales with its size and the risk to meaning it carries: a small cut is one work package, one builder and one assayer; a larger or riskier one has two assayers, so the method never costs more than the change.
reason: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Proportionality said a small cut has one judgment while judgment required two assayers, and small repairs were accepted with none.
